user_query: I'm a teacher planning a math lesson for my students and I need some intriguing facts to captivate their interest. Please share some trivia facts about numbers to make the lesson engaging. Also, recommend a music trivia game to make the class more interactive.

TaskList.description: Gather trivia facts about numbers that can engage students in the math lesson.
Find and recommend a music trivia game that can be used in the classroom to enhance interactivity.
